acip: MA KHYAB NA KHYAB PA YOD PAR THAL, DRI DANG KHA DOG GNYIS KYI GZHI MTHUN MED PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma khyab na khyab pa yod par thal, dri dang kha dog gnyis kyi gzhi mthun med pa'i phyir
english: Just because something is a smell doesn't mean that it can't be a color. And yet it does mean that, because there is no one thing which is both a smell and a color at the same time.
